# 1.2.102 - Foundry's notifications back where Foundry puts them (the curtain's top right whole again), no orange mark in the module's checkboxes and radios, "3 / 4" with no "Left:" on Health and Sanity, Observe back in the actions' one layout, no sideways scroll in the kit windows, Health vermilion and Sanity teal, the curtain's recolour a true crossfade, and the voice tile at the right wall, in the middle of the right side, with its buttons on its own pane

A hotfix of 1.2.101, stage E96, built from v1.2.101 (main 7175878b) and not from the line, which holds E46's work. The
owner played 1.2.101 at a real table on 09.11.2026 and wrote "Cos bardzo zlego sie stalo w 1.2.101"; the causes were
measured by a read-only diagnosis on 1.2.101 and 1.2.100, and four commits mend what it found: E96-C1 5e7e57ba (the
toasts, the checkbox and radio, the reserve's row, Observe, the window body's sideways scroll, the two colours and the
stage ledger), E96-C2 f9eee981 (the curtain's recolour; a cherry-pick of 5ec8e8bf with its registry regenerated) and
E96-C3 7bb13408 and E96-C4 4e4b190c (the voice tile, twice, after the owner's review of the hotfix; cherry-picks of
41f18290 and ca15d778). No merges. **This version adds no setting, no GM store, no socket listener, no bridge row, no flag and no migration**
(Before installing). Nothing in it has been run at a real table or in Foundry; what was measured was measured headless
and in Chromium on the module's own harness pages with stand-ins for Foundry's stylesheet. The gaps are in Known gaps
and Checked. It is published as a full release, never a prerelease (the owner's rule of 09.11.2026).

## Before installing

Nothing to do. The two commits change stylesheets, one language key in English and Polish (`DRPG.Reserve.leftRow`, now
"{n} / {max}"), Observe's window (`columns` no longer asked for), the curtain's turn (`scripts/glass.mjs`), comments in
`character.mjs`, `sheet.mjs` and `states.mjs`, tests, the harness's sweeps and records, the handbooks' "3 / 4" and the
stage ledger. They touch no `settings.mjs`, no `migrate.mjs`, no stored Health or Sanity and no world data. Back up the
world as before any update.

## Foundry's toasts and the curtain's top right (item 1)

The owner: the curtain's layout broken, Foundry's own update error with it; the top right of the screen broken, the
voice panel too high and without its pane.

- **Cause:** 68fd46ca (E23 C5b, B1b). `body.drpg-theme-stained-glass #notifications { position: static; order: 11;
  width: ...; margin: ... }` took Foundry's toast list out of Foundry's own placement, on the unconfirmed guess that the
  list stands in `#ui-top`'s flex column (LIVE-E23-08, never run). The owner's console line at the table read the
  list's parent as an element with no id, a flex row: the unlayered `position: static` had made the list a flex item of
  it. In the diagnosis's stand-in, with the list in `#ui-right`, that column grew from 56 to 512 px and the right column
  and the voice tile moved left with it (x 1468 -> 1122, 1579 -> 1237).
- **Fix:** the four placement declarations apply only to `body.drpg-theme-stained-glass #ui-top > #notifications`; the
  plate the toasts stand on is kept wherever the list stands. In Chromium (glass harness, 2000x1072, a layered
  `position: fixed` stand-in for core, the list in an id-less flex row): before position static, order 11, 416 px, and
  in `#ui-right` that column 56 -> 512 px wide; after position fixed, order 0, the stand-in's 480 px, `#ui-right` 56 px.
- **Test:** R3100 (new, tier 1), red on 7175878b: "measured [["static","11",...],["static","11",...],["static","11",...]]
  (expected nothing stated outside #ui-top)"; green after. R1406 green before and after.

## The orange mark in the module's checkboxes and radios (item 2)

The owner: the settings' tick has no custom icon, and in the windows the orange circle is back.

- **Cause:** 68fd46ca. The one checkbox and radio definition of Stained Glass gave the radio the module's 22 px box and
  its own mark for the first time, but nothing took away Foundry's drawn mark; a long row also squeezed the box (Search's
  fifth radio 13x22, Observe's checked one 12x22).
- **Fix:** in that one definition (`stained-glass.css`), `flex: none`, `--checkbox-checked-color` the state colour and
  `::after { content: none }`. In Chromium with the diagnosis's layered stand-in for core: before, the checked radio's
  and checkbox's `::after` ring glyph in orange on Search, Observe and the Look window; after, `::after` none everywhere
  and every box 22x22. The fix applies to every module window by its selector, and was measured on Search, Observe and the Look window (the owner's screenshot of "Microphone mode" is the module's
  own voice window, inside the definition's scope); Foundry's own core windows never had the module's box. Monokuma
  Legacy: 1.2.101 changed no control rule of `danganronpa.css`, so it is as in 1.2.100.
- **Test:** R3101 (new, tier 1), red on 7175878b: "measured [[null,null,null] x4] for the checkbox and the radio
  (expected ["none", the state colour, "none"])"; green after. R1407 green before and after.

## "Left:" gone from Health and Sanity (item 3)

The owner: 'W karcie postaci na health i sanity jest napis "left"? Po co?'

- **Cause:** 07260705 (E24-C1a), Q-E24-1 run on its default: `DRPG.Reserve.leftRow` read "Left: {n} / {max}"
  ("Zostało: {n} / {max}" in Polish).
- **Fix (the owner's H102-K1 answer):** the key reads "{n} / {max}" in both languages, so the sheet's row, the GM's
  field (" / 4" after it) and every other reader of the row show "3 / 4". The GM and player handbooks, English and
  Polish, say "3 / 4".

  4","?",["Left: "," / 4"]]'; green after. The tests that read the row format the key and follow.

## Observe back in the actions' one layout (item 4)

The owner: the action windows are now inconsistent, Search one way and Observe another; and then, on 09.11: "tu nie
chodzi o to by search i observe mialy ten sam uklad. Chodzi o to by wszystkie AKCJE mialy ten sam uklad, tak jak ten
sam uklad maja wszystkie calle".

## No sideways scroll in the kit windows (items 5 and 7)

The owner: a horizontal scroll in Give / take items, and in the GM panel, whose window is sometimes narrower.

- **Cause:** not found. The diagnosis did not reproduce either scroll: the window body read 545 against 544 (Give /
  take) and 672 against 670 (the GM panel) on 1.2.100 and 1.2.101 alike, one or two pixels from scrolling sideways, with no
  scrollbar drawn.
- **Fix:** `overflow-x: clip` on `.drpg-kit-body` (`components.css`), computed `hidden` beside `overflow-y: auto`, read
  in Chromium on every action page (not read on Give / take items or the GM panel themselves). It is a guard against the pixel the table's fonts and Foundry's stylesheet may add,
  not a mend of a cause seen.
- **Test:** R3103 (new, tier 1), red on 7175878b: "measured [["auto",null],["auto",null]]"; green after.

## The curtain's recolour a true crossfade (item 6)

The owner: the curtain's movement is much better, but as it starts the colours and the textures near the edges
refresh, so the movement is still not seamless.

- **Cause:** f26d4467 (E23 C1b). A turn painted the new look underneath at once and laid the old look over it, baked
  per batch and fading from the centre out; the glass is see-through, so the first frame showed two looks, most on the
  wall panes along the sides.
- **Fix:** `glassTurn` (`scripts/glass.mjs`) bakes the new look per batch too and raises it 0 to 1 on the old layer's
  delay, length and curve while the old falls 1 to 0; each batch's two layers stand in an isolated group with the new
  one added on (`plus-lighter`), so a translucent pane keeps its coverage through the fade. The curtain is held under
  them for the turn's span and steps back in as the last rising layer ends. The glass sweep's `--turn` gains a still
  page that compares the first frame with the screen at rest.
- **Test:** R3120 (new, tier 1), red on 7175878b: 'expected "[true,true,2,true,1,[\"0,0\",true],0]", measured
  "[false,true,0,true,0,null,0]"'; green after, with R1377, R1411, R1412, R1413. `node audit/glass-sweep.mjs --turn`
  (Stained Glass, 1600x900 and 1366x768, GM and player) on 7175878b: TURN RED on every recolour line, e.g. "turn phase
  1600x900 gm ... still 2.53/0.99 (rest 0/0) ... FAIL: the first frame stood 2.53 from rest in the 140 px band along the
  sides and 0.99 inside"; after, every recolour line green, e.g. "turn phase 1600x900 gm ... still 0.5/0.29 (rest 0/0)
  mid 0.99/0.46 tex 2.64/2.5/2.41". The first frame's distance from rest, band / inside: 0.48-0.58 / 0.26-0.34 now,
  2.35-2.64 / 0.97-1.25 at 7175878b (the sweep at 1600x900 and 1366x768; at 2000x1072 up to 0.68 now). The band's texture, rest / first frame / 36 ms (the curtain alone, GM, 1600x900):
  phase 2.64/3.04/2.69 -> 2.64/2.50/2.41; hour 2.64/3.03/2.67 -> 2.64/2.50/2.39; phase-recut 7.75/8.00/12.54 ->
  7.75/6.62/11.91.

## The voice tile's buttons on its own pane (the owner's review, H102-R1 #1)

- **What the owner saw:** on the hotfix's review page the voice (LiveKit) tile's microphone and speaker buttons stood on
  and past its pane's right edge, the pane meeting the Projects tray along part of its width only. The owner: "Panel
  livekit ma wygladac tak samo jak przed 1.2.100. Przyciski maja nie wychodzic poza panel livekit. Panel ma byc
  polaczony z reszta kurtyny."
- **Cause, measured:** not a commit of 1.2.101. On the glass harness with Foundry's tab rail at the wall
  (`?windows=off`), 1.2.99, 1.2.100, 1.2.101 and the hotfix's first two commits read the same: the right column stands
  155-187 px off the wall and tilts, so the tile, 200 px down it, reaches about 28 px past the tray's right edge; both
  buttons had two corners off the pane and the seam with the tray was 176 px under a 191 px tile (2000x1072; the buttons the
  same at 1920x1080; at 1366x768 the column is upright and nothing was off). On the default page all four read the same to the
  pixel with the buttons on the pane; the one change since 1.2.100 is the tile 7 px lower (E23 C3a, the tray in rows).
- **Fix:** `scripts/glass.mjs` `buildColumn`: a column with the voice tile under it that does not touch the right wall
  takes its right edge out to the tile's right side plus the usual pad, and the tray's pane widens with it. After, in
  Chromium with the tab rail: both buttons on the pane, the seam as wide as the tile, the self-check 0 failing blocks at
  every size (2 on 1.2.101); the default page's cut unchanged at the three sizes.
- **Test:** R3121 (tier 1), red first on f9eee981: measured `[["2000x1072",4,false,true],["1920x1080",4,false,true],
  ["1366x768",0,true,true]]`, expected 0 corners off and the seam whole at each size; green after, with R545 and R551.
  The glass sweep's notice and launcher checks at three sizes: 6 of 6 green.

## The voice tile at the wall, in the middle of the right side (the owner's screenshot)

- **What the owner asked, after E96-C3's picture:** "Sam panel jest lepszy, ale jest za wysoko. Dodatkowo, miedzy nim
  a po prawej jest dziura w kurtynie, ktorej nie powinno byc. Raz jeszcze powtarzam: ma byc jak przed 1.2.100. ...
  Ma byc jak na screenie, tylko nizej", with a screenshot of an older version at the table (the tile flush with the right
  wall, its buttons inside its top right corner, its top about 200 px from the screen's top at 2000x1072, just under the Projects tray); asked how
  much lower: "Srodek prawej strony".
- **Fix:** `scripts/glass.mjs`: `settleVoice` centres the tile on the right side (never above its place under the
  tray's five rows); `buildColumn` brings the pane's top down with the tile and cuts a plain pane between the tray and
  the tile; with Foundry's tab rail at the wall the tile stands at the wall where its pane starts below the rail's tiles,
  else at the band's edge, and `cutStrips` cuts the strip around those panes, so no map shows between the tile and the
  right side. In Chromium (the glass harness, GM): the tile's middle at 536 / 540 at 2000x1072 / 1920x1080, half the
  screen's height (434 / 436 before); with the rail, at the wall at 2000 and 1920, and at 1366x768 against the rail's band (its pane reaching
  1296); at all six layouts (both pages, three
  sizes) 0 bare points between the tile's pane and the wall on every row, every corner of both buttons on the pane, the
  name tag on the tile, the tray where it was, the self-check clean.
- **Test:** R3122 (tier 1), red first on 41f18290 (the tile "as high as the tray lets it"; 30, 30 and 23 faults of the
  cut with the rail band at 2000x1072, 1920x1080 and 1366x768, part of them on a test road 41f18290 does not have); green after. R3121 follows the lower tile; the glass sweep's button
  pins re-read at three sizes and 2000x1072 pinned anew (8 lines red at 19 sizes before the re-pin, 0 after); the sweep's notice, launcher and
  voice checks 6 of 6 green on the default page.

## Known gaps

- **The voice tile, E96-C4:** at 1366x768 the tile cannot sit in the middle: the tray's five rows hold it at y 260
  (middle 406 against 384). Its buttons stay where E78 put them, 7 px under the pane's top, not 36 px in as on the
  owner's screenshot. The plain pane between the tray and the tile is new. Not read with a fifteen-tab rail.
- **The voice tile at the table:** the owner's 1.2.101 picture (the tile and its buttons at the screen's right edge with
  no pane under them) was not reproduced on any tree; the diagnosis puts it on the toast list (item 1), which this
  version mends, so the table is the check. "Before 1.2.100" read literally changes nothing (1.2.99 measures as
  1.2.100); the tile's 7 px drop since E23 C3a was kept. E96-C3's "After" above was reshaped by E96-C4 (the next section).

- **Not checked at a real table:** everything in this version. In particular:
  - **The toasts (LIVE-E23-08, AUDIT 409):** the fix stops the module placing the list anywhere but in `#ui-top`, but
    the list's ancestor chain on v14 was not read, and the stand-in with the owner's id-less flex-row parent did not
    reproduce the right column's and the voice tile's move, nor the narrow toast. Whether the top right is whole again
    at the table is to be seen there.
  - **The checkbox and radio:** which pseudo-element v14 draws its own mark in, and whether core's rule is layered and
    without `!important`, was not read (no core stylesheet here); the fix assumes both, as the diagnosis's stand-in does.
  - **The crossfade outside Chromium:** `plus-lighter` was read in headless Chromium only. A browser without it, Firefox
    not read, draws the new layer over the old, and a translucent pane is thinner at the middle of the fade (a*a/4 of
    its coverage for a pane of alpha a).
- **The layout turn's line stays red, on 1.2.101 and on 1.2.102 alike:** `--turn` at 1600x900, GM and player: "the
  texture inside the turn fell to 30 % of rest in the square at 0,512 (3.21/10.84; E23-04: 80 %)". It is the layout
  turn's hold path, which this version does not touch; the sweep cannot read green whole until it is answered.
- **A turn costs more frames:** headless software rendering, 1600x900, GM, three runs, a shape rather than a table's
  number: phase main thread 357/380/403 -> 397/422/436 ms, frame median 167-183 -> 200-217 ms; phase-recut main thread
  420/459/468 -> 438/457/552 ms, frame median 117-133 -> 133-167 ms. At rest nothing changes (`--frame-cost` 143.6 ->
  141.3 ms a frame). A recolour bakes twice the canvases it did.
- **At a turn's first frame, outside the curtain,** the corner launcher's ring and a window's header take the new
  accent at once; seen on whole-screen pictures only. A recut's first frame reads 85-91 % of the band's texture at rest
  (its moving layers are sampled), and its middle 129-162 % on both versions; the still page prints a recut's middle and
  does not judge it.
- **Items 5 and 7 were not reproduced.** The sideways clip is a guard; whether the table's scroll came from the window
  body was not read, nor why the GM panel is sometimes narrower (at the table:
  `document.querySelector(".drpg-gm-panel-window").getBoundingClientRect().width` and the body's `--drpg-sg-scale`).
- **Observe scrolls again at 1366x768 (and in Stained Glass at 1920x1080),** as Search and the other actions do: body scrollHeight / clientHeight, player,
  Chromium, the footer on screen in every case - Stained Glass 1366x768 observe 1140/571 (1.2.101: 427/427 in a 1120 px
  window; now 578 px), search 915/571, analyze 885/571, tamper 897/571, rest 424/424, project 703/571; Stained Glass
  1920x1080 observe 1140/883; Monokuma Legacy 1366x768 observe 815/616 (1.2.101: 316/316 in 1120 px; now 544 px), search
  705/616; Monokuma Legacy 1920x1080 observe 815/815. One layout that fits is E68's.
- **The other window pages' records:** only the six action pages were captured again and swept. Every other kit page's
  style-baseline row still reads `overflow-x: auto` and now computes `hidden`, so the next whole style sweep reports
  those rows until they are accepted; the other 42 captured pages are a capture older than 1.2.101. Both go to the merge
  with the line, where E46's sweeps accept them.
- **Foundry's own windows** (its Configure Settings among them) keep Foundry's checkbox, as they did before 1.2.100.
